authors.stance_zh: 灾难不是背景，是让「微小联结」显影的暗室：莎剧、酒店、画作、派对——都是人对抗熵的仪式。2026 年这套装置第一次直接对准「美国自身的宪政解体会发生什么」；心理上她承认「我无法预测大流行」，预兆之「失灵」正是其自嘲。
authors.stance_en: Disaster as darkroom for small bonds — Shakespeare, hotels, paintings, parties as rituals against entropy. In 2026 the device finally aims at American constitutional collapse itself.

authors.read_status_en: Exit Party: reading; Station Eleven: backlist candidate (against HBO).
authors.why_now_zh: 2026 美国宪政焦虑（政变讨论、中选、AI 失控叙事）的客体化证词——「两个美国」一确二真；'I cannot overstate how stressful the US is at the moment'（irishtimes 2026-09-12）。
authors.why_now_en: The objectified testimony of 2026's American constitutional anxiety — two Americas, one-true-two.
